verdict.rationale: Published pricing is a fair question for a commercial voice-agent API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers per-minute rates, usage pricing, plan tiers or a way to estimate cost per call. The items cover architecture, telephony, LLM providers, the CLI/MCP and data privacy, none of which is about pricing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see published per-minute or usage pricing and estimate cost per call before committing
